facts.text: I am working with an Entity Relationship Model that includes Restaurant, Queue, Customer, Table, Branch, and Period entities.
The Restaurant entity has attributes restaurant_id, name, location, contact_details, and branch_id.
The Queue entity has attributes queue_id, restaurant_id, status, expected_waiting_time, and period_id.
The Customer entity has attributes customer_id, queue_id, name, contact_details, and time_joined.
The Table entity has attributes table_id, restaurant_id, table_number, seats, and status.
The Branch entity has attributes branch_id, name, location, and contact_details.
The Period entity has attributes period_id, start_time, and end_time.
I need to create an Entity Relationship Model to represent the relationships between the data entities and their attributes.
I need to build a MySQL database that implements the ER model according to relational database design principles and populate it with sample data.
